text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Palestinian marksmen shot at Israeli soldiers
- President Weizman: If we don't go forward towards peace, we'll get caught up in war
- Netanyahu to meet Dole in Washington today
- British financial adviser proposed postponing public offering for Nehushton metals in London due to the situation in Israel
- Budget deficit in September lower than expected -- 87 million shekels ($1=3.15 shekels)
- Prime minister rejects firm deadline on Hebron
- "Israel's attitude" caused Mubarak to skip summit
- Forces on alert in case summit breaks down
- Palestinian Authority officer: Orders were to shoot at Israeli forces if they fire in the air
